Overview

Grudziądz is a city in Kuyavian-Pomeranian with a population of 93,864. A historic city on the Vistula River, known for its impressive Gothic granaries, medieval old town, and a strong agricultural tradition. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
